nodes.label: SSH Tunnel Skill
nodes.rationale: The command is named ssh-tunnel rather than ssh so it does not shadow the system SSH client; it runs its own sshd on a dynamically allocated in-container port so auth is fully controlled and containers never conflict on ports.

nodes.label: bore Public TCP Relay
nodes.rationale: bore.pub is a free public relay that picks a new public port on every tunnel start; intended for temporary sessions only, never long-term persistent access. Stopping the tunnel is what makes the machine unreachable while sshd and authorized keys stay in place.
